build_convnext_model: build a ConvNeXt model with specified depths and dims for image feature extraction
get_convnext_arch: create a ConvNeXt model variant using get_convnext_arch with a size name like convnext_base
get_intermediate_layers: extract intermediate layer features from a ConvNeXt model with optional normalization and reshaping
forward_features: run forward_features on a ConvNeXt model to get CLS tokens and patch tokens as a list of dicts
drop_path_regularization: apply stochastic depth drop path regularization to tensor inputs during training
